statement: A request Cell invokes a named, policy-authorized Call Binding through a worker-to-parent host-call protocol (bounded shared-buffer request/response with request ids, one outstanding call per Cell, stale and late results never visible, worker termination and deadline detected, no main-thread blocking) and a RequestCellCallBridge owner that only authorizes, preserves the frozen security context and the min-of-outer-and-inner deadline, derives the system-owned child invocation identity from the outer identity, enforces the one-nested-call limit and call-chain recursion refusal, delegates to the one canonical CallCellInvoker, and maps failures to the stable typed terminal-or-retryable surface without leaking internals, with outer-request replay returning the journaled response without re-invoking the inner Binding.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
